title: Consolidated nightshift coverage + temporary P1/P2 response waiver request
text:
Consolidated nightshift coverage + temporary P1/P2 response waiver request

['From: Paul Thomas <paul.thomas@finedge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Night maintenance window + expected spike (heads-up)

Rishi —

Quick heads-up: we’ve scheduled a database maintenance for our EU region between 2027-07-02 01:00–05:00 UTC to apply a security patch. We expect a higher-than-normal stream of P1/P2 alerts as some background jobs restart; engineering estimates a ~60–90 minute elevated incident risk between 01:30–03:00 UTC.

Could Redwood consider a temporary modification to overnight on-call coverage for FinEdge next weekend (Q3 maintenance) so we can consolidate alerts to a single triage path and avoid duplicate paging? We’d like agreement on an exception to the standard P1/P2 response windows for that night with a defined escalation path.

Attaching our planned maintenance steps and pre-checks.

Thanks,
Paul
Head of Platform — FinEdge
[Attachment: maintenance_plan.pdf]
', 'From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Thomas <paul.thomas@finedge.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night maintenance window + expected spike (heads-up)

Team —

I spoke with Paul; FinEdge is asking for a one-off consolidation of alerts and a limited waiver on our standard overnight P1/P2 response SLAs for 2027-07-02 01:00–05:00 UTC. Proposed Redwood approach:

- Consolidate FinEdge alerting to a single on-call engineer (night triage lead) for that window.
- Provide an extended acknowledgement window (P1: 15 min -> 30 min; P2: 60 min -> 120 min) but maintain remediation targets.
- Require a Redwood-runbook + a joint communication channel (Slack/Bridge) and a guaranteed escalation to a 2nd responder if not acknowledged within the extended window.

I’ve drafted a short coverage plan and a proposed rota (see coverage_plan.xlsx attached). Need:
- Vivek: ops risk assessment and confirmation we can support single-engineer triage + automated suppression rules for duplicated alerts.
- Laura / Aditya: approval to temporarily adjust SLA commitments for FinEdge for that maintenance window and sign-off on customer comms.

Can each of you respond by EOD Wed so I can confirm with FinEdge and document the exception?

—Rishi
Principal Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: coverage_plan.xlsx]
', 'From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night maintenance window + expected spike (heads-up)

Rishi —

Quick notes from ops after reviewing the plan and our runbooks:

- Single-engineer triage is feasible if we apply an automated dedupe policy and set clear page routing to the night lead. I recommend the following mitigations be mandated before we grant a waiver:
  1) Pre-seeding of KV cache and warming of critical endpoints (FinEdge ops must confirm).
  2) Enable temporary additional logging retention for 72h for this account (we’ll store incident_history_72h.csv).
  3) A hands-on escalation step: if P1 not acknowledged within extended 30 min, the page escalates to a dedicated hot-seat (senior on-call) within 10 min of the missed ack.

- Risk: if a rolling failure occurs across multiple shards, single-person triage will increase MTTR. We should limit the waiver to the 4-hour maintenance window only and require a post-mortem within 48 hours.

If FinEdge agrees to the mitigations above I’m comfortable with the temporary SLA adjustment. I’ll update the coverage_plan.xlsx with the routing rules and suppression policy.

—Vivek
Director, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ops_notes.txt]
', 'From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Thomas <paul.thomas@finedge.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night maintenance window + expected spike (heads-up)

Thanks for the clear plan and for capturing the mitigations. Approve conditional waiver for 2027-07-02 01:00–05:00 UTC with the following conditions:

1) FinEdge must confirm the pre-seeding and endpoint warm-up in writing by 2027-07-01 20:00 UTC.
2) Vivek to publish the exact suppression rules and escalation hook in the coverage_plan.xlsx (no changes less than 4 hours before the window).
3) Customer-facing SLA language will be an exception addendum and must be signed by customer (DocuSign link to follow).
4) Mandatory post-mortem within 48 hours with metrics (time-to-ack, time-to-resolution, alerts deduped).

Rishi — please confirm you’ll send the exception addendum to Paul with the updated coverage_plan and the DocuSign for their signature. Copy legal on the addendum.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
', 'From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Paul Thomas <paul.thomas@finedge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night maintenance window + expected spike (heads-up) — confirmation + next steps

Paul —

Thanks for the quick coordination. Per Laura/Vivek’s notes, Redwood will accept a one-night SLA exception for 2027-07-02 01:00–05:00 UTC provided you confirm the pre-warm steps and sign the exception addendum. I’ve attached the updated coverage plan with suppression and escalation rules (coverage_plan.xlsx) and a short summary I’ll include in the DocuSign.

Next steps:
- FinEdge to confirm pre-warm and reply-all by 2027-07-01 20:00 UTC.
- I’ll open the DocuSign and copy legal (DOCUSIGN-REQ-8921).
- Vivek will publish the suppression rules; I’ll post the final runbook link to the shared drive.
- We’ll run the required post-mortem and share metrics within 48 hours of window close.

Thanks — looking forward to the confirmation.

—Rishi
Principal Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: coverage_plan.xlsx, incident_history_72h.csv]']
